metadata.market_context: Fed raised the federal funds target to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16; online rates were repricing upward in Oct 2026. Rates are variable and move often.

field_notes.apy.value_percent: Headline rate for a typical new customer, excluding temporary promos.
field_notes.apy.floor_value_percent: Rate if no conditions are met. null = unknown.
field_notes.apy.max_value_percent: Highest rate reachable (promo, tier or conditions).
field_notes.null_values: null means unknown or not captured; see missing_fields.
field_notes.unconfirmed_fields: Values filled from general knowledge or weak sources.
field_notes.eligibility.minimum_age / maximum_age: null maximum_age = no upper limit; null in either = not captured.

verification_status_values.verified_third_party: Rate seen in a dated third-party source within about 3 weeks, with no conflicting figure.
verification_status_values.needs_review: Conflicting, older, partial or assumed data. Treat as indicative.
